title: Temple of Power
objective: Stabilize CI by completing all forge gates.
intro: The forge has gone cold. Pass four chambers to prove each commit can be built, linted and tested before the fire is lit.

trials.title: Light the Forge
trials.prompt: Put the CI job steps in the order the forge must run them.
trials.hint: Code has to exist and its tools must be installed before anything can check it. Packaging comes last.
trials.success: The first flames catch. Checkout, install, lint, test, package: the safe order.

trials.title: Names on the Anvil
trials.prompt: Match each GitHub Actions keyword to what it does.
trials.hint: 'on' is about when. 'runs-on' is about where. 'needs' is about waiting.
trials.success: Every rune on the anvil answers to its name.

pairs.right: Starts the workflow when code is pushed
Chooses the machine that runs the job
Makes one job wait for another
Saves build output for later stages
Repeats a job across several versions

trials.title: The Cursed Workflow
trials.prompt: Ganonix edited this workflow so failures slip through. Flag the lines that let broken code pass.
trials.hint: Look for commands that can never fail, and settings that let a failed step be ignored.
trials.success: Found them. A check that cannot fail protects nothing.

trials.title: The Bellows Room
trials.prompt: Five sigils control the forge. Light the ones that keep the build safe and leave the shadow's tricks dark.
trials.hint: Three sigils help the forge. The two that say 'skip' or 'direct' are Ganonix's work.
trials.success: The bellows roar. Lint, tests and caching burn bright; the shortcuts stay dark.
clues: Every commit must be linted and tested before it can merge.
Caching dependencies makes the forge faster without hiding failures.
Skipping tests and pushing straight to main are the shadow's tricks.

switches.label: Skip tests when in a hurry
